acceptanceCriteria: A combined per-example record keyed by a stable example identity carries the run outcome, the test-validity verdict and the source revision/blob both used.
The join is refused with a typed code when the receipt and verdict revisions differ.
Spec requirements and tests cover a shifted-line case and a shared-group example.
body: From GitHub issue beamfall/corvint#1291 (opened 2026-10-20). Feature request; not yet specified. A consumer that accepts a passing test as evidence needs two facts about the same example: it ran and passed (provider receipt), and its assertions are meaningful (test-validity verdict). Today these are separate documents with no shared key, so consumers must join them by file:line heuristics. That breaks when lines shift or an example comes from a shared group. Ask: emit (or allow requesting) a combined record per selected example, keyed by a stable example identity, with the run outcome, the validity verdict and the source revision/blob both were computed on. Refuse the join when the revisions differ. See beamfall/corvint#1291 for the full text.
title: Join an example-level test receipt to its test-validity verdict in one record (issue #1291)
